title: Fluroscent Microscopy Setup
desc: The Olympus SZX16 stereo microscope setup is designed to study collective dynamics of C. elegans in two-dimensional environments. Its wide field of view and high numerical aperture enable simultaneous monitoring of spatiotemporal patterns across large nematode populations. To facilitate high-throughput tracking, the high-contrast fluorescence axis helps isolate flexible, moving organisms from the background.

title: Magneto-optical Study Setup
desc: This experimental setup is designed for magneto-optical studies of liquid crystals, allowing for the precise control of magnetic fields and temperature. It features a customized Holmarc HO-EM7000S electromagnet which can produce upto 3 Tesla magnetic field, and a Julabo Dyneo DD-800F temperature controller with precision of upto 0.1 degrees.

title: Polarization Microscopy Setup
desc: The setup is designed for electro-optical studies in liquid crystal. It features a Leica DM4P Polarization Microscope and Linkam T96 S Temperature controllers for precise temperature control and optical measurements.

title: Optical Studies Setup
desc: The setup featuring Ametek TMC Vibration Controlled Optical Table is designed for custom optics experiments. The facilities has various optical-analysis accessories including Keithley digital multimeters, Stanford Lockin amplifier, Julabo Presto and Instec Temperature controllers, custom and pre-made optical stages, various lasers and precision photo-detectors, and high-quality coated lenses.

title: Cell Fabrication Facility
desc: Cell Fabrication facility is designed to fabricate custom planar and homeotropic liquid crystal cells for precision electro and magneto-optical studies. The setup includes ultrasonic bath for cleaning, Apex EZ Spin A1 for spin-coating alignment films on ITO glass, and Rotek hot air oven for thermal curing. For planar alignment, the Holmarc rubbing machine creates uniform micro-grooves. The MBR Ultrasonic soldering system helps attach clean, flux-free electrical contacts to the ITO layers.

title: High-Speed Imaging Facility
desc: The facility is equipped with Phantom High Speed KT1640 camera featuring a 4.2-megapixel Back Side Illuminated (BSI) sensor. It captures 3,760 fps at full resolution and up to 421,050 fps at reduced sizes.
